headline: Session done — 2x10min climbs delivered clean, now shut it down and protect the taper
summary:
Solid execution: both climb reps landed in band (interval summary shows ~6-7min blocks at 157-159bpm, well inside the 163-170 ceiling with no overshoot), descents stayed controlled, and feel was 2/Good with RPE 5 — a clean, conservative delivery of a session that was already trimmed for amber readiness. Load logged at 70 (icu_training_load) against 65 planned, right on target once you account for the usual HR-based load accounting. No pain or ITB signal reported. This was the last quality touch before Valtellina — from here it's travel (Sofia Tue-Thu) and shakeout only, so the job now is just absorbing this and arriving fresh on the 7th.</summary>
